sections.heading: History
sections.text:
At some unknown point, Tersly joined the Huntik Foundation and became an assistant to Montehue, based at the Post Street Museum. [The Legacy of Thor]

Eventually, Tersly was visited by Dante Vale and some of his team, who were searching for information on the Hammer of Thor, Mjolnir. Tersly told Dante what he knew, and also about his suspicions of Thor being a seeker, before Dante left. Later, Montehue returned to the museum where Tersly worked and managed to get Tersly to tell him about Dante and his team's mission for the hammer of Thor, and the two left to join them. They caught up with them on the Rainbow Bridge in Iceland, where Tersly used Venadek while Montehue used his axes to help fight off Frost Minions. They all then proceeded to enter the Temple of Thor and follow one of the guardians of Thor. [The Legacy of Thor]

Tersly and Montehue later joined the team outside King Solomon's mines where they helped defeat the three colossi, Ashtoreth, Milcom and Chemosh. Venturing into the mines to find the Legendary Titan of Spirit, Tao, Tersly invoked Red Searcher helped study and translate the instructions to open the vault, dressing Lok and Sophie in the garments of King Solomon and the Queen of Sheba. When the Organization arrived, Tersly invoked Venadek to help the team hold them off and give Lok time to succeed in invoking Tao. [To Be Together]

After the fall of the Professor, Tersly was seen present as the surprise party at Dante Vale's house to congratulate the Huntik team on their victory and the recovery of Metz. [The Mission]

Tersly and Montehue later joined the Huntik team on a mission to recover the Ring of Phoenix. After being ambushed by some Casterwill Hunters, Tersly saved Den Fears from falling into a lava tube. He later invoked Red Searcher to help find the entrance to the labyrinth so they could destroy the Lodestone. Tersly remained outside the cave to help navigate the team through the maze but was interrupted by a lioness. When the Lodestone was destroyed, Tersly invoked Venadek, scaring off the animal. [The Dead Magic Island] Tersly later helped Montehue hold off the Blood Spiral to give the Huntik team time to enter the Phoenix Volcano and recover Phoenix. [The Phoenix's Ashes]

On the longest night of the year, Tersly traveled with the Huntik Foundation on the Scramjets to the Spiral Mark. He was saddened to hear of Dante's death but accompanied Montehue onto the battlefield. [Lok and the Betrayer] In the midst of battle, Tersly and Montehue climbed aboard one of the jets that were being bombarded by Wind and Shakrit. Tersly managed to stabilize the controls while Montehue and Momax used Mjolnir to defeat the enemy Titan. After the defeat of the Betrayer, Tersly was seen celebrating the victory with the other Foundation and Casterwill family members. [Dante's Return]

sections.heading: Personality
sections.wikitext:
[[File:S2E51_Tersly.png|170px|thumb]]
Although Tersly is quite intelligent, he possesses no street smarts, and little fighting ability. He tends to interrupt romantic times to talk of his research work without noticing his being inopportune, with his bad timing being noticed especially by [[Zhalia Moon]] as well as [[Lok Lambert]]. {{source|To Be Together}} He tends to be very goofy and naïvely innocent. He also fears anything which has the potential to hurt him. His passions include both Celtic and Norse mythology and his scientific research. He can also be quite cowardly when fighting with the other Seekers. {{source|Two Powers Become One}} However, he appears to have grown in confidence seen in his attempts to rescue [[Den Fears]] {{source|The Dead Magic Island}} and help [[Montehue]] against the [[Blood Spiral]]. {{Source|The Phoenix's Ashes}}

He tends to interrupt romantic times to talk of his research work without noticing his being inopportune, with his bad timing being noticed especially by Zhalia Moon as well as Lok Lambert. His passions include both Celtic and Norse mythology and his scientific research. He can also be quite cowardly when fighting with the other Seekers. Abilities

Image caption: Tersly invokes Venadek

As a Seeker, Tersly is capable of using spells and invoking Titans, although he is not a very powerful and often shies away from confrontation. Nevertheless, Tersly has extensive knowledge, particularly that of Celtic and Norse mythology, which proves highly valuable in to uncovering of ancient secrets and treasures.
